Capture the blowout action of WWE Superstars with this Elite Collection action figure! Featuring one of WWE's biggest personalities and champions, this bold and colorful figure is approximately 6-inches and comes ready to wreak havoc right out of the box!
Candice LeRae is cooler than ever in Mattel WWE Elite 87! She's sporting a confident head sculpt and periwinkle hair and has a purple, pink, black and grey studded stretch-design ring top.
She has purple and pink wrist tape, a purple, pink and green studded stretch-design pair of trunks and is wearing purple knee pads and black and white laced ring shoes.
LeRae also includes interchangeable hands with painted nails and a removable entrance jacket with blue and purple winged designs in the back and purple and green sleeveless studs in the front!
Price: $19.99
